FX-PAGETURN-001.says: The settings as they start: the bottom right corner turned up to three quarters of the way across and down, Fold Radius 30. On a drawing 16 pixels wide a cylinder that size has rolled the whole page up and out of the frame: clear.

FX-PAGETURN-002.says: Classic, the fold line upright down the middle, the page travelling right, Fold Radius 0: the left half turned over flat onto the right, showing its back, the paper colour #f0f0f0, cut to the page's shape; the left half is clear.

FX-PAGETURN-003.says: The same with Back Opacity 0: the back shows the page's own picture seen through, so the right half is the left half mirrored.

FX-PAGETURN-004.says: The same with Back Opacity 100 and the layer itself as the Back Page: the back is the page's picture again, so the frame is FX-PAGETURN-003's.

FX-PAGETURN-005.says: Classic down the middle, Fold Radius 2: the fold rolls round a cylinder two pixels across, its back shaded where it curls, the turned part laid down past it.

FX-PAGETURN-006.says: FX-PAGETURN-005 with Render Front: only the page's front, no back.

FX-PAGETURN-007.says: FX-PAGETURN-005 with Render Back: only the back; laid over FX-PAGETURN-006 it gives FX-PAGETURN-005.

FX-PAGETURN-008.says: FX-PAGETURN-005 lit from the right, Light Direction 90: the curl's crest faces left, away from the light, and darkens, where lit from the upper left, as it starts, it shows the paper.

FX-PAGETURN-009.says: The bottom right corner turned to the middle, Fold Radius 1: the corner laid flat on the middle, its back the paper colour, the lower right of the frame clear.

FX-PAGETURN-010.says: The top left corner turned to the middle, Fold Radius 1.

FX-PAGETURN-011.says: The bottom right corner's Fold Position keyed from (100, 100) at frame 0 to (0, 0) at frame 4, linear, Fold Radius 1: frame 0 the page as it was, then turned ever further, frame 2 FX-PAGETURN-009.

FX-PAGETURN-012.says: Classic as it starts, Fold Direction -60, the line through the middle, Fold Radius 2: the lower right part turned up and to the left.

FX-PAGETURN-013.says: FX-PAGETURN-002 with Paper Color #2040a0: the back is blue.

FX-PAGETURN-014.says: FX-PAGETURN-002 with Back Page a layer that is not in the composition, `gone`: the paper colour, as FX-PAGETURN-002, and the warning every frame.

FX-PAGETURN-015.says: FX-PAGETURN-009 with the layer moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-PAGETURN-016.says: FX-PAGETURN-002 with Back Opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: frame 0 FX-PAGETURN-003, frame 4 FX-PAGETURN-002, frame 2 half way.

FX-PAGETURN-017.says: Classic, Fold Radius 1, Fold Direction keyed from 90 at frame 0 to 450 at frame 4: the fold line turns a whole turn about the middle, frames 0 and 4 the same.

FX-PAGETURN-018.says: Classic down the middle, Fold Radius eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: frame 2 would pass 1000 and is held there, the same as frame 4.

FX-PAGETURN-019.says: Controls "middle", not a word it takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-020.says: Render "sides", not a word it takes. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-021.says: Fold Radius 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-022.says: Fold Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-023.says: Back Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-024.says: Paper Color "white", not a colour. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-025.says: Back Page written as the number 3, not a word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-026.says: Fold Position at (50, 1001), past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PAGETURN-027.says: Fold Direction keyed to 3601 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
